Versatile Garden Tool



This versatile tool is not just for grass cutting; it's also perfect for pruning bushes and trees, enhancing your garden's beauty.






Easy to Use



Designed for ease of use, this trimmer requires minimal effort, allowing you to spend more time enjoying your garden.






Eco-Friendly



As an electric trimmer, it operates without the need for gasoline, making it an eco-friendly choice for your garden.






High Power Electric Trimmer



Equipped with a powerful electric motor, this trimmer ensures efficient and effective grass cutting, making garden maintenance a breeze.






Durable Construction



Built with durability in mind, this trimmer is designed to withstand regular use, ensuring long-lasting performance.

aiTexts: This Brushless Electric Lawn Mower features a wireless design for unrestricted movement in small to medium lawns and gardens.
It offers adjustable comfort with a tweakable cutting angle, 90-120cm retractable rod, and a movable auxiliary handle for stable control.
Powered by a fast-charging all-copper motor, it cuts tough grass efficiently while weighing just 1.2kg to minimize arm fatigue.
Dual blades include rust-proof plastic for soft grass and wear-resistant stainless steel for tougher vegetation, with tool-free replacement.
Safety features include a dual safety trigger switch and a removable blade cover to protect users and prevent grass splash.

product.desc:
【About our shop】

The item is Ready and will be shipped directly from Local.Shipping time：Same day delivery on working daysArrival: 2 to 3 days after order.

【1.2kg Ultra-Light Wireless Lawn Mower】

Easy to Use for Everyone—Safe, Portable & Pain-Free!Whether you’re an elderly gardener, a busy parent, or a beginner, this wireless electric lawn mower is designed for you. It’s lightweight, safe, and requires no heavy lifting or technical skills—making weeding a breeze for the whole family.

【✋Ultra-Light & Ergonomic—No More Fatigue】

At only 1.2kg, it’s light enough for kids (under adult supervision) to help with small tasks! The retractable rod (90-120cm) adjusts to your height—tall or short, you can stand straight while mowing, no more bending or stooping. The soft-grip auxiliary handle reduces hand strain, letting you work for hours without tiredness.

【🛡️Dual Safety Protection—Peace of Mind】

Safety first! Equipped with an independent safety switch and trigger switch—accidental startup is impossible (both switches need to be activated). Perfect for families with kids or pets roaming the yard. The removable blade cover adds an extra layer of protection, preventing injuries from exposed blades.

【🔋Wireless & Fast-Charging—Mow Anywhere, Anytime】

Cable-Free Convenience: No need to drag heavy extension cords or hunt for power outlets. Mow the front yard, backyard, or even remote areas (like roadside weeds) with total freedom.

Quick Charging: Battery charges fast, and the indicator light shows when it’s ready. One full charge handles most small to medium-sized yards—enough for your daily weeding needs.

【💪Dual Blades & Durable Build—Value for Money】

Versatile Blades: 4 plastic blades for regular mowing (gentle on lawns, rust-proof) and 2 stainless steel blades for tough weeds (sharp, wear-resistant). Blades are interchangeable and fit most lawn trimmers—save money on extra parts.

Long-Lasting Material: ABS body is impact-resistant (can handle accidental bumps with rocks), and stainless steel components resist rust and corrosion—even with frequent outdoor use.

  • 【Dual Safety】: Safety + trigger switch (anti-accidental use, kid/pet-friendly); removable cover (protects blades, stops grass splash).
  • 【Powerful & Light】: All-copper motor cuts tough grass/thatch; only 1.2kg, no arm fatigue.
  • 【Dual Blades】: Plastic (soft grass/seedlings, rust-proof); stainless steel (tough grass, wear-resistant). Tool-free replacement.
